title: Practice: On Monday, this week, last month, next year

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The days of the week are not capitalized. «Во» before «вт» for euphony. В + Accusative** is used: (a) to indicate the time of the day; (b) to indicate the day of the week; (c) to indicate how frequently something occurs. В + Prepositional** is used: (a) to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place; (b) to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period in which an event takes place. — DLI, Lesson 19.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The days of the week are not capitalized. (DLI, Lesson 19)
